body:
Found in an independent adversarial review of #1007 (head `612860e4`). Medium.

**Where:** `tests/test_ingredient_bundle_dependency_refresh.py` (around lines 35, 167, 185–188).

**What happens:** the tests hard-code the live canonical header date `2026-11-01` and read the repository's own `mappings/ingredient_mappings.sssom.tsv`. The next PR that moves the header date breaks two unrelated tests: `test_semantics_columns_and_invalid_date_refused` fails on a bare `assert old in current[name]`, and `test_valid_but_stale_header_refused` turns into a no-op replacement, so no Rule G error is raised and the test no longer tests anything.

**Suggested fix:** read the header date from the file under test, or run against a frozen fixture copy instead of the live SSSOM.
title: Bundle dependency-refresh tests hard-code the live SSSOM header date
